title: Named Account Managers and the Rush Charge on Re-Issued Network and Server Quotes
content:
The re-issue rush charge on a re-issued Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote that lapsed unsigned is owed only when the quote carries rush. It is nothing for a client whose active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement assigns it a named technical account manager, who books the rush allocation with the distributor directly; **75.00 USD** when that active agreement assigns it a named client success manager and no technical account manager; and the order type's rush fee for every other client: 150.00 USD on a Network Equipment Order, 350.00 USD on a Server & Storage Build Order.

Whether a named technical account manager or a named client success manager is assigned is read from the coverage of the client's ClearPath agreement whose status is active.

| Quote carries rush | Named technical account manager | Named client success manager | Network Equipment Order | Server & Storage Build Order |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | either | nothing | nothing |
| Yes | No | Yes | 75.00 | 75.00 |
| Yes | No | No, or no active agreement | 150.00 | 350.00 |
| No | any | any | not owed | not owed |
